versions.content: The function HTMSS_GetTestStatus shall provide the start up and shutdown test status depend on the input parameter GrpId. Hint: The integrator/user shall ensure that a valid test status is readily available before invoking this API function. Note: The methods/mechanisms to read/collect the requested test status are implementation specific and depending on the MSTP interfaces and microcontroller manufacturer specific guidelines.
